advice: Avoid skin injury and scratching. Stop smoking and alcohol. Control weight. Do not stop steroid ointment abruptly.
name: Psoriasis vulgaris (limited plaques)

rx.instr: Apply on body plaques at night, then weekends only
Use INSTEAD of clobetasol (not together on the same plaques); once daily up to 4 weeks, then weekends for maintenance

rx.sig: Do not apply at the same time/site as calcipotriol (salicylic acid inactivates it); use on scales at a different time of day
